description: Read a buyer's reply to a quote you sent: does it accept, say the price is too high, counter, ask a question, or decline? Send text, with quoted_price and currency when known. Returns accept, too_high, counter, question, decline or unclear, confidence, option probabilities (null for keyword rules), and counter_price when found. The existing decision model reads the reply, falling back to keyword rules when unavailable; source says model or rules. The reply may be sent to the model provider and the evaluation may incur model usage cost. Last Price does not retain the reply text; analytics records the decision without that text. This call does not accept a deal or change a price. Answers 404 not_released while unavailable for the workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with pcn:routing:read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: Three-character currency of the quoted price, echoed in uppercase.

quoted_price.description: The price you quoted, when known. A counter equal to it is not read as a counter price.

name: read_quote_reply
